TGO.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
Lab recruits for public-sector AI projects; no administration system piloted or in service stated.

facts.fact: Togo First says Togo AI Lab, led by the Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation with CEGA at Berkeley, is recruiting a technical lead to oversee machine-learning, generative AI and satellite-imagery tools for sectors including agriculture, health, education and the environment.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation

facts.fact: Togo First says Togo AI Lab is developing models that understand and generate content in several Togolese languages, within a national local-languages project using LLMs, RAG and AI agents.
